center_circuit.basis_rotation: map measured I/X/Y/Z data Pauli to Z parity using local Clifford rotations
center_circuit.flag_entangler: CNOT flag->syndrome after data interactions 1 and 3

edge_circuit.purpose: redundant K4 core receipt and fault-propagation path

recovery.type: classical Pauli-frame update; no physical recovery gate
recovery.decoder: frozen release/branches.json ideal-center minimum-weight Pauli lookup

policy: If any center flag, detected data loss, stale receipt or missing receipt: do not accept.
Map observed b to old syndrome s and update the Pauli frame using the frozen decoder.

repeated_state_machine.syndrome_estimator: bitwise majority of the three complete unflagged center b frames
pre_recovery_fail_closed: any stale or missing center/edge receipt -> HOLD
repeated_state_machine.recovery: apply one classical Pauli-frame update from the majority syndrome
verification_acceptance: center syndrome relative to updated Pauli frame = 0000
repeated_state_machine.accepted_single_fault_output_requirement: protected logical class I and dressed residual weight <=1 modulo gauge

fault_campaign_A_clean_input_single_faul.input: clean code state / arbitrary gauge state
fault_classes: all 15 nonidentity two-qubit Pauli faults after every declared two-qubit gate
X/Y/Z after every declared data basis-rotation Clifford
X/Y/Z syndrome-ancilla reset/preparation fault before each check
X/Y/Z flag-ancilla reset/preparation fault before each center check
one measurement-bit flip on any center syndrome, center flag or edge receipt
X/Y/Z data idle fault at every declared inter-check boundary
stale receipt metadata fault on any round record
missing receipt metadata fault on any round record
ideal-detected data loss at any declared inter-check boundary -> QUARANTINE
ideal-detected syndrome/flag ancilla loss in a check -> HOLD
fault_campaign_A_clean_input_single_faul.loss_detection_assumption: ideal erasure/loss indication for this mathematical state-machine test; missed-loss hardware modeling remains OPEN
fault_campaign_A_clean_input_single_faul.acceptance: Every single-fault case must finish as ACCEPT with protected logical I and dressed residual <=1, or detected HOLD/QUARANTINE.

fault_campaign_B_input_error_no_circuit_.inputs: all 24 single-qubit nonidentity Pauli errors on 8 data qubits
fault_campaign_B_input_error_no_circuit_.acceptance: Repeated state machine must ACCEPT with protected logical I and zero center syndrome after Pauli-frame recovery and verification.

noisy_decoder_benchmark.scope: phenomenological syndrome readout only; separate from circuit-level campaign
noisy_decoder_benchmark.input_ensemble: uniform over the 24 single-qubit Pauli errors, conditioned on one incoming error
noisy_decoder_benchmark.bit_flips: independent across 4 center bits and across rounds
noisy_decoder_benchmark.one_round_decoder: frozen lookup on one noisy b frame
noisy_decoder_benchmark.repeated_decoder: bitwise majority of 3 noisy b frames, then frozen lookup
noisy_decoder_benchmark.metric: conditional protected-logical failure probability after Pauli-frame recovery
noisy_decoder_benchmark.report: exact polynomial/rational coefficient ledger in q; no fitted q

stop_rules: Any accepted single-fault case with nonidentity protected logical class is FAIL.
Any accepted single-fault case with dressed residual weight >1 is FAIL.
Do not repair the frozen protocol after seeing failures; version a successor and rerun fresh.
Do not promote phenomenological readout results to circuit or hardware performance.
